def commit_tags(sha1):
    # type: (str) -> List[str]
    """ Get the name of the tags that this commit belongs to. """
    cmd = ["git", "tag", "--contains", sha1]
    result = subprocess.check_output(cmd)
    return [x.strip() for x in result.splitlines()]


def commit_message(sha1):
    # type: (str) -> str
    """ Get the message of the commit with the given sha1. """
    cmd = ["git", "log", "--format=%B", "-n", "1", sha1]
    result = subprocess.check_output(cmd)
    return result.strip()


def commit_date(sha1):
    # type: (str) -> str
    """ Get the date of the commit with the given sha1. """
    cmd = ["git", "log", "--format=%aD", "-n", "1", sha1]
    result = subprocess.check_output(cmd)
    return result.strip()


def commit_author(sha1):
    # type: (str) -> str
    """ Get the author of the commit with the given sha1. """
    cmd = ["git", "log", "--format=%an", "-n", "1", sha1]
    result = subprocess.check_output(cmd)
    return result.strip()


def commit_email(sha1):

    cmd = ["git", "log", "--format=%ae", "-n", "1", sha1]
